description: Flat record-level metadata schema for ITS amplicon sequencing of fungal communities in agricultural soils under different management practices.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual soil sample or sequencing record.

project_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to the parent study or project.

site_name.descr: Name of the farm, field, or experimental site where the sample was collected.

plot_id.descr: Unique plot or subplot identifier within the field/site.

management_practice.descr: Agricultural practice applied to the plot; examples include conventional tillage, no-till, and organic farming.

crop_type.descr: Crop species or cropping system present at the time of sampling.

sampling_date.descr: Date of soil collection in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sampling_time.descr: Local time of soil collection, if recorded, in 24-hour format.

soil_depth_cm.descr: Sampling depth interval in centimeters, for example 0-10 cm.

replicate_number.descr: Biological replicate number for the sample within the study design.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees.

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees.

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling location in meters above sea level.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Gravimetric or volumetric soil moisture content, reported as percent (%).

organic_matter_percent.descr: Soil organic matter content as percent (%).

soil_ph.descr: Soil pH measured in the specified soil:water or soil:CaCl2 suspension.

total_nitrogen_percent.descr: Total soil nitrogen content as percent (%).

available_phosphorus_mg_kg.descr: Plant-available phosphorus concentration in mg/kg soil.

exchangeable_potassium_mg_kg.descr: Exchangeable potassium concentration in mg/kg soil.

nitrate_n_mg_kg.descr: Nitrate nitrogen concentration in mg/kg soil.

ammonium_n_mg_kg.descr: Ammonium nitrogen concentration in mg/kg soil.

carbon_percent.descr: Total soil carbon content as percent (%), if measured.

bulk_density_g_cm3.descr: Soil bulk density in g/cm^3, if measured.

fungal_dna_extraction_kit.descr: Name of the DNA extraction kit or protocol used for soil DNA extraction.

dna_extraction_date.descr: Date of DNA extraction in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD), if recorded.

its_region_targeted.descr: ITS region amplified, such as ITS1, ITS2, or full ITS.

forward_primer_sequence.descr: Forward primer sequence used for ITS amplification.

reverse_primer_sequence.descr: Reverse primer sequence used for ITS amplification.

pcr_cycle_number.descr: Number of PCR cycles used for amplicon generation.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used, for example Illumina MiSeq or NextSeq.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for the sequencing run or merged reads.

library_preparation_method.descr: Brief description of library preparation workflow used for sequencing.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Identifier for the sequencing run or lane associated with the sample.

raw_read_count.descr: Number of raw reads generated for this sample.

filtered_read_count.descr: Number of reads retained after quality filtering and trimming.

merged_read_count.descr: Number of paired-end reads successfully merged, if applicable.

chimera_filtered_read_count.descr: Number of reads remaining after chimera removal.

asv_count.descr: Number of amplicon sequence variants detected in the sample.

otu_count.descr: Number of operational taxonomic units detected in the sample, if OTU-based processing was used.

observed_fungal_richness.descr: Observed fungal richness based on ASVs or OTUs.

shannon_index.descr: Shannon diversity index for fungal community diversity.

simpson_index.descr: Simpson diversity index for fungal community diversity.

dominant_fungal_taxon.descr: Most abundant fungal taxon detected at the chosen taxonomic resolution, if summarized.

relative_abundance_percent.descr: Relative abundance of the dominant taxon or target taxon, expressed as percent (%), if summarized.

bioinformatics_pipeline.descr: Name and version of the bioinformatics pipeline used for sequence processing.

reference_database.descr: Taxonomic reference database used for ITS classification, such as UNITE, including version if known.

taxonomic_assignment_method.descr: Method used to assign taxonomy, for example naive Bayes, BLAST, or RDP classifier.

quality_threshold_score.descr: Minimum quality score threshold applied during read filtering.

min_read_length_bp.descr: Minimum read length retained after trimming, in base pairs.

max_read_length_bp.descr: Maximum read length retained after trimming, in base pairs.

is_control_sample.descr: True if the record is a control sample such as a blank or mock community; false otherwise.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the sample, processing, or measurements.
